instruction: This exercise focuses on improving your footwork by incorporating a combination of balance and coordination drills. Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward. Step your left foot forward, keeping your left knee bent and your right foot following a slight angle. Your arms and torso should remain stationary. Hold for a few seconds, then switch to the right foot and repeat on the other side. Repeat for 30-60 seconds, alternating sides. This exercise targets your balance and coordination, while improving your footwork. Remember to maintain proper form and avoid excessive lifting or twisting of the legs.
